headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Telangana Today / Times of India / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: Mahua Moitra alleges attack on her convoy by BJP supporters.
Revanth left disappointed Siddipet people as he fails to grant any special funds.
Odisha ITI trainee tops female candidates with 1,194 marks, earning national recognition.
BJP Karnataka MLC’s close aide dies after falling from moving train.
Video of Bihar CM’s security ‘pushing’ Nishant sparks row.
bullets_ur: Mahua Moitra ne BJP karkunan par apnay qafly par hamlay ka ilzam lagaya.
Revanth ne Siddipet ke awam ko mayoos kiya, koi khusoosi funds nahi diye.
Odisha ITI trainee 1,194 marks le kar khawateen mein top, qaumi shohrat hasil ki.
BJP Karnataka MLC ka qareebi saathi chalti train se gir kar halak ho gaya.
Bihar CM ki security ki janib se Nishant ko ‘dhakka dene’ ki video par tanaza khara.
